|-----------|-------------|
| `fabricName` | Name of the fabric (e.g., `"test-de"`). |
| `nodeId` | **Numeric** ID of the node you want to query. |
| `podId` | Numeric ID of the pod that contains the node. |
| `interfaceType` | One of `"svi"`, `"ethernet"`, `"loopback"`, `"port‑channel"`. |
| `infoType` | One of `"interfaces"`, `"status"`, `"statistics"`, `"errors"`.

```python

    fabricName="test-de",
    nodeId=<NODE_ID>,          # e.g., 12345
    podId=<POD_ID>,            # e.g., 1
    interfaceType="ethernet",  # or whichever interface you’re interested in
    infoType="status"          # or "interfaces", "statistics", "errors"
)
```

If you need help finding the node’s numeric ID or pod ID from its IP address, let me know and I can walk you through the steps (e.g., querying a device inventory service or using SNMP).
